name: Augustine of Hippo
knownFor: Bishop and theologian whose Confessions tell his restless search and conversion. His thought on sin and grace shaped Catholic and Protestant theology alike.
practice: Pray your story to God, as the Confessions do.
caution: Protestants and Catholics read him differently on grace and the church; read as a witness, not a final authority.

name: Monica
knownFor: Mother of Augustine, remembered for years of persevering prayer for her son. Our main source is Augustine's Confessions.
practice: Keep praying for one person over years without a deadline.

name: Athanasius of Alexandria
knownFor: Defender of the full deity of Christ at and after Nicaea, often against the stream, and exiled several times. His On the Incarnation is a classic.
practice: Hold a first-order truth steadily when it is unpopular.

name: Anthony of Egypt
knownFor: Early desert hermit whose life, told by Athanasius, drew many to solitude and prayer. Often called a father of monasticism.
practice: Take a short stretch of real solitude to pray.
caution: Later accounts add legend; treat details as tradition.

name: Macrina the Younger
knownFor: Sister of Basil of Caesarea and Gregory of Nyssa; a teacher and ascetic who shaped her brothers, as told by Gregory in his Life of Macrina.
practice: Teach your own household by quiet example.

read.title: Life of Saint Macrina (Gregory of Nyssa)

name: Benedict of Nursia
knownFor: Wrote the Rule that shaped Western monastic life around prayer, work, study and hospitality.
practice: Order the day around prayer and work: a simple rule of life.
caution: A Catholic monastic rule; borrow the rhythm, test it against Scripture.

name: Patrick
knownFor: A former slave who returned to Ireland as a missionary and wrote a brief Confession of his calling.
practice: Pray where you work, and make a habit of gratitude for rescue.
grade: CONSENSUS on the broad story; dates uncertain
caution: Many legends gather around him; only the Confession and a letter are firmly his.

name: Francis of Assisi
knownFor: Gave up wealth to live in poverty and preach the gospel; founded the Franciscans; praised for love of creation.
practice: Practice simplicity: give something up to love Christ and neighbour freely.
caution: Many popular stories are later and sentimental.

name: Teresa of Avila
knownFor: Carmelite reformer and writer on prayer, especially in The Interior Castle.
practice: Treat prayer as friendship, a plain talking with the one who loves you.
caution: Visions and mystical states are her own testimony; Protestants read her for devotion, not as a pattern for experience.

name: Brother Lawrence
knownFor: A kitchen worker whose conversations and letters, compiled as The Practice of the Presence of God, show prayer in ordinary work.
practice: Do ordinary tasks as if with God present.

read.title: The Practice of the Presence of God (CCEL)

name: Martin Luther
knownFor: Augustinian monk who recovered the gospel of justification by faith alone and sparked the Reformation; translated the Bible into German.
practice: Write down what Scripture tells you about grace and pray it back.
caution: His writings include harsh statements about Jews and others that must be named plainly and rejected.

name: John Calvin
knownFor: Pastor and theologian of the Reformation; his Institutes shaped Reformed theology.
practice: Read Scripture in order and pray what you read.
caution: Reformed views on election are disputed with Arminians; talk with your pastor.

name: John Wesley
knownFor: Preacher and organiser of the Methodist revival, with an emphasis on assurance and holiness of heart and life.
practice: Meet with a small group to confess and encourage.
caution: Wesleyan views on perfection and free will differ from Reformed readings.

name: George Whitefield
knownFor: Field preacher of the Great Awakening, whose preaching drew very large crowds on both sides of the Atlantic.
practice: Speak plainly of the new birth to someone this week.
caution: Whitefield held slaves and defended slavery, which must be faced honestly.

name: Jonathan Edwards
knownFor: Pastor and theologian of the Great Awakening; wrote on the religious affections and true revival.
practice: Write resolutions and review them often.
caution: He is often reduced to one sermon on wrath; read his work on beauty and the affections too.

name: Charles Spurgeon
knownFor: Prince of preachers at the Metropolitan Tabernacle; wrote Morning and Evening and The Treasury of David.
practice: Read a Psalm slowly and speak it back to God.
caution: He suffered with depression; his honest struggle is itself instructive.

name: Amy Carmichael
knownFor: Missionary who rescued children from temple service and wrote devotional books and poems.
practice: Offer daily work as a gift with no audience.

name: Corrie ten Boom
knownFor: Hid Jews in WWII, survived Ravensbruck, and spoke widely about forgiveness; author of The Hiding Place.
practice: Forgive by an act of the will, then ask for the feelings.

name: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
knownFor: Pastor and theologian who opposed the Nazi regime and was executed; wrote The Cost of Discipleship and Life Together.
practice: Confess sin to a trusted brother, as in Life Together.
caution: His later prison thoughts on religionless Christianity are debated; start with Life Together.

name: A. W. Tozer
knownFor: Pastor and author of The Pursuit of God and The Knowledge of the Holy, on hunger for God.
practice: Pray slowly through one attribute of God.
